name: The Ancient Leaf
label: Quest
description: The Ancient Leaf: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The epidermis of the leaf glows a bright green. The surface is extremely rugose, exposing several veins and wrinkles.
If you had to take a guess, you would say this leaf came from something ancient and powerful.
Maybe you should find the original owner of this leaf?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Of course I recognize my own leaves. Look at that! It's in perfect condition.
How good of you to return it, adventurer.
Perhaps you could be of service to us and we to you.
